title: Geophysics MicroseismicBrief

stats.done_summary: Completed microseismic monitoring analysis brief. Analyzed station geometry (5 surface stations) and arrival time picks (12 total) to identify 3 microseismic events. Located 2 events with sufficient picks (5 stations each) using global optimization with a homogeneous P-wave velocity model (4.5 km/s). Events form a tight spatial cluster at shallow depth (z≈0 km) near the western edge of the array, with inter-event distance of 127 meters and temporal separation of 2.5 seconds. Generated comprehensive report with methodology, results, 8 figures (map view, cross-sections, 3D view, depth histogram, temporal evolution, location quality, and arrival residuals), and structural interpretation.
